spectators.label: Glow-stick otaku
spectators.look: chubby, sweaty young superfan with a red bandana and round glasses; pink happi coat with a white heart pattern over a white tee, jeans, a backpack with poster tubes sticking out, a glowing pink stick in one hand and a blue one in the other
spectators.idle: glow sticks crossed at his chest, grinning eagerly
spectators.cheer: glow sticks swinging in big arcs overhead

spectators.label: Fan girl with heart fan
spectators.look: small fan girl with pink twin tails and yellow star hair clips; white tee with a pink star print, pink skirt, pink sneakers, a round handmade hand fan decorated with a big red heart and glitter
spectators.idle: heart fan held to her chest, starry-eyed

spectators.label: Happi-coat dad
spectators.look: middle-aged fan dad with a balding head and a thin side comb-over, a blue headband; blue happi coat with a white wave pattern over a gray shirt, khaki slacks, a long white fan towel around his neck
spectators.cheer: swinging the towel in circles overhead

spectators.label: Glow-claw commander
spectators.look: tall skinny superfan with long stringy black hair and round glasses; orange happi coat with a yellow star pattern, black pants, four colorful glowing sticks gripped between the fingers of each hand like claws
spectators.idle: glow-stick claws hanging at his sides
spectators.cheer: glow-stick claws thrust out to the sides
spectators.shocked: glow sticks scattering from his fingers

spectators.label: Fan with glitter board
spectators.look: young woman with short purple hair and a star sticker on her cheek; oversized neon green hoodie, black skirt, white sneakers, a big rectangular handmade board decorated with glitter stars and a big heart (no words)
spectators.cheer: board lifted high over her head

spectators.label: Idol costume fan
spectators.look: teen girl in a homemade replica idol stage outfit: aqua-and-white frilly dress with ribbons, cat-ear headband, wavy light-brown hair, white boots, a glowing star wand
spectators.cheer: idol pose with the wand pointed up and a wink
spectators.shocked: cat ears knocked askew, wand drooping

spectators.label: Merch-laden collector
spectators.look: bespectacled collector with spiky dark-blue hair under a cap with plush bear ears; vest covered in plain round pin badges, cargo pants, a tote bag dripping with plush keychains, two stuffed shopping bags
spectators.cheer: shaking the tote so the keychains jingle

spectators.label: Fan-club granny
spectators.look: spry little granny with a white hair bun and a pink headband; pink happi coat with white hearts over a lilac blouse, gray slacks, a round heart-patterned hand fan in each hand
spectators.shocked: fans dropped, hand on her cheek

spectators.label: Fan-club leader with megaphone
spectators.look: muscular fan-club leader with a black crew cut and a red headband with a white heart; white happi coat with red trim, black pants, red sneakers, a red megaphone
spectators.idle: megaphone held at his side, scanning the crowd
spectators.cheer: shouting through the megaphone, other arm out to the side

spectators.label: Fan with heart balloons
spectators.look: cheerful girl with an orange bob and freckles; pastel yellow happi coat over a white tee, denim overall shorts with leggings, holding a small bunch of pink heart-shaped balloons

spectators.label: Little fan in big happi
spectators.look: little boy with messy black hair and star-shaped toy glasses; oversized purple happi coat reaching his ankles, red sneakers, a small glowing yellow stick
spectators.cheer: jumping with the glow stick held up

spectators.label: Towel-waving fan
spectators.look: sporty woman with a high black ponytail and a black cap; black concert tee, red track pants, white sneakers, a long fan towel with bold red-and-white stripes
spectators.cheer: towel stretched taut overhead between both hands
spectators.shocked: towel dropped, both hands on her head

spectators.label: Light-up headband girl
spectators.look: lively girl with navy hair in a high bun and a headband with two glowing heart boppers on springs; silver satin tour jacket, black skirt, glowing pink and cyan bracelets on both wrists
spectators.idle: bopping her head so the heart boppers wobble
spectators.shocked: heart boppers springing wildly, mouth open
